adjudication.rationale: In the newly added `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts` handler there is no HTTP method guard (it will run for GET/PUT/etc.), and it uses throwing operations without a try/catch: `appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body)` will throw on missing/invalid body (e.g., GET where `req.body` is empty), and `symmetricDecrypt(...)` + `JSON.parse(...)` can also throw on an undecryptable/non-JSON `keys` blob or missing/invalid `CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` (it falls back to `""`). These exceptions will surface as raw 500s rather than a controlled 4xx response, making the endpoint noisy to probe and potentially leaking error details via default error handling.
